title: Connection leaves room for an earlier image

captions.energy: Distinguishing a conclusion’s grounds and weight

meaning: Relating personal impressions to material can clarify the weight of different foundations while preserving room for farewell to an earlier shared picture.
text: Farewell to an earlier picture can continue within an understandable fresh relationship. Temperance in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly relating personal impressions to material. Justice in energy supports distinguishing the weight of foundations. Death in emotions experiences a familiar image’s ending. A simple shared account may remain dear. Wanting observations considered proportionately preserves each response’s actual place, allowing understanding to change without devaluing the entirety of earlier experience together.

Suppose you considered a favourite park a quiet place outside city life. One person notices activity while the other notices secluded paths. You relate responses to an open square and dense planting. **Connection can refine a picture while leaving room to release an earlier image.** Proportionate consideration reveals different parts of one space. An account of complete detachment loses its leading role. Its simplicity may be missed while another connection is understood. Walks retain value without immediately ceasing to love an earlier impression or defending it as exclusively correct.

The risk is declaring an earlier feeling entirely mistaken for a fair fresh judgement. Attention to foundations preserves scale. Seclusion concerned particular paths. Your view can retain their significance while farewell accompanies refinement without devaluing a familiar picture or restoring its all-encompassing reach simply because parting still feels sad to either person.
